type.title: Type
type.description:
The declared type of this repository. Leave it empty to keep the behaviour of earlier versions, where a repository serves uploads and proxies whatever is listed under mirrored repositories.
HOSTED - stores uploaded artifacts and proxies nothing.
PROXY - proxies external URLs only and caches what it fetches; it takes no uploads.
GROUP - proxies local repositories only and stores nothing; it takes no uploads.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short plain-text description shown in the repository list.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Labels to group and find repositories, e.g. team or purpose.

redeployment.title: Redeployment
redeployment.description: Does this repository accept redeployment of the same artifact version.

preserveSnapshots.title: Preserved snapshots
preserveSnapshots.description: By default, Ingot deletes all deprecated build files. If you'd like to preserve them, set this property to true.

quota.title: Quota
quota.description: Control the maximum amount of data stored in this repository. Supported formats: 90%, 500MB, 10GB (optional, by default: unlimited)

mount.title: Mount
mount.description: Use custom directory to locate the repository data (optional, by default it's './repositories/{name}')

oneOf.title: File system Storage Provider
oneOf.description: Local file system (disk) storage provider settings

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: Overwrite AWS access-key used to authenticate (optional)

secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: Overwrite AWS secret-key used to authenticate (optional)

prefix.title: Key Prefix
prefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to all object keys, e.g. to scope data within a bucket shared with other services

sharedBucket.title: Shared Bucket
sharedBucket.description: Namespace objects under the repository name so several repositories can share one bucket (optional)

expireAfterAccessSeconds.title: Expire After Access
expireAfterAccessSeconds.description: Expire cache entries after the specified number of seconds since last read access

expireAfterCreationSeconds.title: Expire After Creation
expireAfterCreationSeconds.description: Expire cache entries after the specified number of seconds since the initial download

allOf.title: S3 Metadata Cache
allOf.description: Caches things like file size from S3 objects

allOf.title: Local Metadata Cache
allOf.description: Local metadata cache settings (optional). The default is no caching. NOTE: This cache is local only. If you run multiple instances, they will not share the cache!

pathStyleAccess.title: Path Style Access
pathStyleAccess.description: Address the bucket as https://host/bucket/key, which most S3-compatible servers such as MinIO need (optional). When unset, the JVM property reposilite.s3.pathStyleAccessEnabled decides

storageProvider.title: Storage provider
storageProvider.description: The storage type of this repository.

storagePolicy.title: Storage policy
storagePolicy.description:
Defines how Ingot should handle requests to repository with configured mirrored repositories.
PRIORITIZE_UPSTREAM_METADATA - try to fetch the latest version of the artifact from the remote repository
STRICT - prioritize cached version over upstream metadata (full offline mode)

metadataMaxAge.title: Max age of metadata file
metadataMaxAge.description:
Fetching metadata files with PRIORITIZE_UPSTREAM_METADATA may be slow, so you can use dedicated TTL threshold for them.
If set to "0" then a fetch is done always. (Default: 0 seconds)

resolutionCacheMaxEntries.title: Resolution cache size
resolutionCacheMaxEntries.description:
Caches routing decisions for metadata reads (maven-metadata.xml, *.pom, *.module, Ivy XML) to speed up repeated requests. Size scales with the number of distinct GAVs touched through your mirrors, not with user traffic:
0 — disabled (no mirrors, or caching not needed)
128 — proxying a small fixed set of artifacts (single vendor SDK, internal repos)
512 — proxying focused ecosystems (BOM + transitives, a few curated mirrors)
2048+ — proxying broad ecosystems like Maven Central
(Default: 0)

proxied.title: Mirrored repositories
proxied.description: List of mirrored repositories associated with this repository.

reference.title: Link
reference.description: Either the id of other local repository or the URL of a remote repository.

store.title: Store
store.description: Ingot can store proxied artifacts locally to reduce response time and improve stability.

allowedGroups.title: Allowed Groups
allowedGroups.description: Allowed artifact groups. If none are given, all artifacts can be obtained from this mirror.

allowedExtensions.title: Allowed Extensions
allowedExtensions.description: List of accepted file extensions. If none are given, all files can be obtained from this mirror. Use the special value '<none>' to permit files without an extension (e.g. native binaries).

connectTimeout.title: Connect Timeout
connectTimeout.description: How long Ingot can wait for establishing the connection with a remote host. (In seconds)

readTimeout.title: Read Timeout
readTimeout.description: How long Ingot can read data from remote proxy. (In seconds)

login.title: Login
login.description: Login or custom header name to use

password.title: Password
password.description: Raw password or header value used by HTTP client to connect to the given repository

authorization.title: Mirror Credentials
authorization.description: The authorization credentials used to access mirrored repository.

httpProxy.title: HTTP Proxy
httpProxy.description:
Custom proxy configuration for HTTP/SOCKS client used by Ingot to connect to the mirrored repository. Examples:
HTTP 127.0.0.1:1081
SOCKS 127.0.0.1:1080 login password

authenticatedFetchingOnly.title: Authenticated Fetching Only
authenticatedFetchingOnly.description:
Whether to require an authenticated connection before fetching uncached artifacts from the remote repository.
_This should only ever be turned on in conjunction with the store option or with a secondary mirror host that has this option turned off.
If you are looking to hide this mirror from unauthenticated connections, please use repository visibility options instead._

checksumPolicy.title: Checksum policy
checksumPolicy.description:
How Ingot checks the artifacts stored from this mirror against the checksum files of the same host.
ignore - stores the copy without a check (Default)
warn - stores the copy, and logs a mismatch or a missing checksum file
fail - stores and serves a copy only when it matches the sha256 file of the host, or the sha1 file when the host has no sha256 file; otherwise the host is refused and the next host is tried
Needs Store to be enabled. Metadata and checksum files are not checked.

protectedGroupPrefixes.title: Protected group prefixes
protectedGroupPrefixes.description:
Group ids, such as net.onelitefeather, that this group serves from its hosted members only. A proxy member is never asked for a coordinate under such a prefix, so a public upstream cannot answer for it. A prefix covers its subgroups, and a coordinate that no hosted member holds is answered as not found.
Only a repository of the type GROUP accepts this key. Empty disables the rule (Default: empty)

uploadChecksumPolicy.title: Upload checksum policy
uploadChecksumPolicy.description:
What Ingot does with an uploaded checksum file (.md5, .sha1, .sha256 or .sha512) that does not match the artifact stored before it. The check only runs when the artifact is already stored.
ignore - stores the checksum file without a check
warn - stores the checksum file and records the mismatch in the audit log
reject - refuses the checksum file with 400, stores nothing and records the refusal in the audit log
Leave it empty to use the instance default, which is set by INGOT_UPLOAD_CHECKSUM_POLICY and is ignore when unset.

versionPolicy.title: Version policy
versionPolicy.description:
Which versions this repository accepts on deploy. Leave it empty to accept both release and snapshot versions, as before.
RELEASE - refuses a deploy into a -SNAPSHOT version directory with 400
SNAPSHOT - refuses a deploy into any other version directory with 400; maven-metadata.xml and its checksums are always accepted
MIXED - accepts both, the same as leaving it empty
Only for hosted and untyped repositories. Reads, deletes and cleanup runs are not affected.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.description:
Set to true to refuse every deploy and delete into this repository with 405, while reads keep working. Scheduled cleanup skips the repository. This is separate from the read-only mode of the whole instance, which answers 503.
Only for hosted and untyped repositories. Leave it empty or false to accept writes as before.

format.title: Format
format.description: The repository format. Leave it empty for Maven (maven2), which is the only format of this version.

resolutionCacheClusterMaxAgeSeconds.title: Resolution cache maximum age in cluster mode
resolutionCacheClusterMaxAgeSeconds.description:
Maximum age in seconds of a cached routing decision (see Resolution cache size) when a cluster bus is configured. Entries expire after this age even when an invalidation was not delivered.
Without a cluster bus this value is ignored and entries keep their current lifetime.
0: use the cluster default of 300 seconds
(Default: 0)
